introduction: The `agentspec` Go core package ports the non-AI portions of the Python `agentspec` library to Go, providing error types, TOML configuration loading, campaign directory lifecycle management, session state machine with atomic persistence, and tool schema definitions that sit between the `afspec` format library and the `spec` CLI.

glossary.AF_SPEC_MODEL: Environment variable that, when set, overrides the model field from any config file.
glossary.AgentError: Richest error type carrying Detail, ErrorCategory, Retryable, HTTPStatus, and an Unwrap() method preserving the original error.
glossary.AgentSpecConfig: Go struct holding model and provider configuration loaded from config.toml.
glossary.AgentSpecError: Base Go error interface for all agentspec errors; matchable via errors.As and exposing a Category() string method.
glossary.ArtifactTool: Function returning the Anthropic tool definition for submitting a named artifact type.
glossary.Assessment: Go struct capturing PRD quality assessment output: Quality, Summary, Gaps, and Questions.
glossary.AssessmentTools: Function returning the Anthropic tool definition list for the assessment phase.
glossary.Campaign: Go struct holding a filesystem path and CampaignMetadata representing an agentspec campaign directory.
glossary.CampaignError: Error type returned for campaign directory operation failures such as duplicate path, missing campaign.yaml, or invalid spec name.
glossary.CampaignMetadata: Go struct holding name, description, created_at, and updated_at for a campaign.
glossary.CleanSchema: Function that strips title fields, default fields, and the top-level $schema field from a JSON Schema map while preserving description fields.
glossary.ConfigError: Error type returned for invalid TOML syntax, missing required config fields, or symlinked config files; Category() returns "config".
glossary.CreateCampaign: Function that initializes a new campaign directory by writing campaign.yaml atomically.
glossary.CreateSession: Function that initializes a new SpecSession in StateInit and persists it to _session.json.
glossary.ErrorCategory: String field on AgentError classifying the error kind; valid values are rate_limit, auth, transient, overloaded, input, internal, validation, refusal, context_window, pause_turn.
glossary.GenerateResult: Go struct returned after artifact generation containing Artifacts list, Validation result, and Warnings.
glossary.InlineRefs: Function that recursively resolves $ref references against $defs in a JSON Schema map, removing $defs from the result.
glossary.LastError: Go struct recording the most recent error encountered during a session operation.
glossary.LoadConfig: Function that searches for config.toml in .specs/ then ~/.specs/ and returns an AgentSpecConfig.
glossary.LoadSpec: Existing afspec function that loads a spec from a directory path into a Spec struct.
glossary.NewSpec: Method on Campaign that provisions a new spec directory with prd.md and an initial SpecSession.
glossary.OpenCampaign: Function that reads and parses an existing campaign.yaml to reconstruct a Campaign.
glossary.ParseSpecDirName: afspec function that parses a directory name of the form {NN}_{snake_case} into numeric prefix, name, and validity flag.
glossary.QAExchange: Go struct recording a set of answers to assessment questions at a point in time.
glossary.RefinementTools: Function returning the Anthropic tool definition list for the refinement phase.
glossary.RenderCombined: afspec method on Spec that renders all artifacts into a single combined string.
glossary.RenderIndividual: afspec method on Spec that renders each artifact into a separate string keyed by artifact name.
glossary.RepairSuggestion: Go struct describing a suggested fix for a validation error, including whether it is auto-fixable.
glossary.ResumeSession: Function that reads _session.json and reconstructs a SpecSession.
glossary.Schemas: afspec function returning a map of embedded JSON Schema files keyed by artifact type name.
glossary.SessionError: Error type returned for illegal state transitions or invalid session state; Category() returns "state".
glossary.SessionState: String type enumerating the valid states of a SpecSession: StateInit, StateAssessing, StateRefining, StatePRDAccepted, StateGenerating, StateGenerated.
glossary.SessionValidationResult: Go struct returned by Validate() containing Valid flag, SchemaErrors, IntegrityErrors, and RepairSuggestions.
glossary.SpecSession: Go struct representing the stateful session for authoring a single spec, persisted to _session.json.
glossary.StateAssessing: SessionState indicating the session is undergoing PRD quality assessment.
glossary.StateGenerated: SessionState indicating all artifacts have been successfully generated.
glossary.StateGenerating: SessionState indicating artifact generation is in progress.
glossary.StateInit: Initial SessionState assigned when a SpecSession is first created.
glossary.StatePRDAccepted: SessionState indicating the PRD has been accepted and is ready for artifact generation.
glossary.StateRefining: SessionState indicating the session is in iterative Q&A refinement.
glossary._session.json: JSON file inside a spec directory that persists SpecSession state atomically.
glossary.archive: Subdirectory within a campaign directory holding retired or archived spec directories.
glossary.atomic temp-file-and-rename: File write pattern that writes to a temporary file then renames it to the target path, ensuring the target is never partially written.
glossary.campaign.yaml: YAML file at the root of a campaign directory that stores CampaignMetadata.
glossary.config.toml: TOML configuration file read by LoadConfig; may reside in .specs/ (local) or ~/.specs/ (global).
glossary.prd.md: Markdown file with YAML frontmatter written into a new spec directory by NewSpec.
glossary.schema_version: Integer field in prd.md frontmatter fixed at 1 for all newly provisioned specs.
glossary.spec directory: Subdirectory within a campaign matching the {NN}_{snake_case} naming pattern that holds all files for a single spec.
glossary.submit_assessment: Anthropic tool name used during assessment; accepts quality, summary, gaps, and questions.
glossary.submit_prd_update: Anthropic tool name used during refinement; accepts an updated_prd string.

correctness_properties.title: All agentspec errors are matchable via errors.As
correctness_properties.for_any: error value returned by any agentspec function
correctness_properties.invariant: errors.As(err, &target) where target is of type AgentSpecError returns true, and target.Category() returns a non-empty string

correctness_properties.title: AF_SPEC_MODEL always overrides config file model
correctness_properties.for_any: call to LoadConfig when AF_SPEC_MODEL is set to a non-empty string
correctness_properties.invariant: the returned AgentSpecConfig.Model equals the value of AF_SPEC_MODEL regardless of what config.toml specifies

correctness_properties.title: Config file search order: local before global
correctness_properties.for_any: call to LoadConfig when both .specs/config.toml and ~/.specs/config.toml exist
correctness_properties.invariant: the returned AgentSpecConfig is populated solely from .specs/config.toml and the global file is not read

correctness_properties.title: Atomic writes never leave partial files
correctness_properties.for_any: any file write operation in agentspec (campaign.yaml, prd.md, _session.json)
correctness_properties.invariant: after the write operation completes or fails, the target path either contains the complete new content or the pre-existing content; no partial file is observable at the target path

correctness_properties.title: Session state transitions are persisted atomically
correctness_properties.for_any: any successful state transition on a SpecSession
correctness_properties.invariant: after the transition method returns nil, _session.json reflects the new state; if the write fails, the in-memory state is reverted to match the pre-transition _session.json

correctness_properties.title: AcceptPRD only succeeds from valid predecessor states
correctness_properties.invariant: the method returns nil if and only if the pre-call state was StateAssessing or StateRefining; otherwise it returns a SessionError and the state is unchanged

correctness_properties.title: InlineRefs produces schemas with no $ref or $defs keys
correctness_properties.for_any: call to InlineRefs with any schema map
correctness_properties.invariant: the returned map contains no key named $ref or $defs at any nesting level, provided all referenced definitions exist in $defs

correctness_properties.title: CleanSchema preserves description fields
correctness_properties.for_any: call to CleanSchema with any schema map containing description fields
correctness_properties.invariant: every description field present in the input is present in the output at the same nesting path

correctness_properties.title: Spec directory numeric prefixes are strictly monotonically increasing
correctness_properties.for_any: sequence of calls to Campaign.NewSpec on the same campaign
correctness_properties.invariant: each new spec directory's numeric prefix is strictly greater than the maximum prefix among all existing active and archived spec directories at the time of the call

correctness_properties.title: ResumeSession is the inverse of CreateSession
correctness_properties.for_any: SpecSession created by CreateSession with given specDir, mode, and source
correctness_properties.invariant: ResumeSession(specDir) returns a SpecSession with identical state, mode, prd_path, assessment_history, qa_exchanges, generated_artifacts, and last_error fields

execution_paths.title: Create campaign and provision first spec

steps.action: calls CreateCampaign with a new directory path, name, and description
validates parent directory exists and campaign.yaml is absent
writes campaign.yaml atomically using temp-file-and-rename
returns *Campaign to caller
calls Campaign.NewSpec with specName, prdPath, mode, and source
validates specName against [a-z][a-z0-9_]* and reads prdPath
scans active and archive directories to compute next numeric prefix
creates spec directory and writes prd.md with YAML frontmatter and PRD body
initializes SpecSession in StateInit and writes _session.json atomically
returns *SpecSession to caller
sets AF_SPEC_MODEL environment variable and calls LoadConfig
checks for config.toml in .specs/ relative to current working directory
falls back to ~/.specs/config.toml if local file is absent
parses the found config.toml, reading [model] and [provider] sections
overrides Model field with AF_SPEC_MODEL value
returns AgentSpecConfig to caller
calls ResumeSession with an existing specDir
reads and unmarshals _session.json from specDir
reconstructs SpecSession with all persisted fields and returns it
calls SpecSession.AcceptPRD
verifies current state is StateAssessing or StateRefining
transitions state to StatePRDAccepted and persists _session.json atomically
returns nil to caller

execution_paths.title: Build artifact tool schema for requirements

steps.action: calls ArtifactTool with artifactName "requirements"
calls Schemas() to retrieve the embedded JSON Schema map
calls InlineRefs on the requirements schema to resolve all $ref references
calls CleanSchema to strip title, default, and $schema fields
embeds the cleaned schema as the content property of the submit_requirements tool definition
returns []map[string]any containing the submit_requirements tool to caller
calls SpecSession.Validate on a session with some missing artifact files
calls LoadSpec(specDir) which fails due to missing artifacts
falls back to loading individual JSON artifact files that are present
runs validation on available artifacts and categorizes errors
returns SessionValidationResult with Valid=false and error details to caller

execution_paths.title: List campaign specs sorted by prefix

steps.action: calls OpenCampaign with an existing campaign directory path
reads and parses campaign.yaml using go-yaml Unmarshal
returns *Campaign to caller
calls Campaign.Specs
reads subdirectory names from the campaign directory
calls ParseSpecDirName on each name, filters matches, excludes archive/
sorts matching names by numeric prefix and returns the sorted slice to caller

error_handling.condition: config.toml resolved path differs from original path (symlink detected)
error_handling.behavior: LoadConfig returns (AgentSpecConfig{}, ConfigError) describing the symlink rejection; no config values are applied
LoadConfig returns (AgentSpecConfig{}, ConfigError) wrapping the TOML parse error

error_handling.condition: campaign.yaml already exists when CreateCampaign is called
error_handling.behavior: CreateCampaign returns (nil, CampaignError) without modifying the existing file

error_handling.condition: atomic temp-file write or rename fails during campaign.yaml creation
error_handling.behavior: CreateCampaign cleans up the temporary file and returns (nil, CampaignError); no partial file remains at the target path

error_handling.condition: campaign.yaml is missing or malformed when OpenCampaign is called
error_handling.behavior: OpenCampaign returns (nil, CampaignError) wrapping the underlying error

error_handling.condition: specName does not match [a-z][a-z0-9_]* when NewSpec is called
error_handling.behavior: Campaign.NewSpec returns (nil, CampaignError) without creating any directories or files

error_handling.condition: _session.json is missing when ResumeSession is called
_session.json contains malformed JSON when ResumeSession is called
error_handling.behavior: ResumeSession returns (nil, SessionError) wrapping the JSON parse error

error_handling.condition: SpecSession.AcceptPRD is called when session state is not StateAssessing or StateRefining
error_handling.behavior: AcceptPRD returns SessionError without modifying session state or _session.json

error_handling.condition: atomic persistence of state transition to _session.json fails
error_handling.behavior: AcceptPRD reverts in-memory state to pre-transition value and returns the error

error_handling.condition: ArtifactTool is called with an artifactName not in {requirements, test_spec, tasks}
error_handling.behavior: ArtifactTool returns an empty slice without panicking

error_handling.condition: Schemas() does not contain an entry for the requested artifactName in ArtifactTool
error_handling.behavior: ArtifactTool returns an empty slice without panicking

error_handling.condition: InlineRefs encounters a $ref pointing to a definition not present in $defs
error_handling.behavior: InlineRefs leaves the unresolvable $ref in place and continues processing the rest of the schema
CreateSession cleans up the temporary file and returns (nil, error); no partial _session.json remains

error_handling.condition: Campaign.Specs cannot read the campaign directory due to filesystem permissions
error_handling.behavior: Campaign.Specs returns (nil, CampaignError) wrapping the OS error
